children.name: Vahlia capensis  Thunb.
children.description: The native range of this species is Northern Prov. to Cape Prov.. It is a annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Vahlia dichotoma  Kuntze
children.description: The native range of this species is Sahara to Dry Trop. Africa, Madagascar, India to Assam, Sri Lanka. It is a annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Vahlia digyna  Kuntze
children.description: The native range of this species is Egypt to Dry Trop. Africa, Madagascar, Iraq to Arabian Pen., Pakistan to India, NW. Sri Lanka. It is a annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Vahlia geminiflora  Bridson
children.description: The native range of this species is Sahel to Egypt, Iraq to Iran. It is a annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Vahlia somalensis Chiov.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & S. Ethiopia to E. Kenya. It is a annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
